53: extern void wpas_thread_start(void);

58: int wifi_init(const wifi_init_config_t *config)
59: {
60: 	int ret;
61: 
62: 	/* init workqueue */
63: 	bk_workqueue_init();
64: 
65: 	/* power up Wi-Fi MAC and PHY */
66: 	//enable mac and phy power
67: 	bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_WIFIP_MAC, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
68: 	bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_PHY, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
69: 	bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_SUB_MODULE_NAME_PHY_WIFI,PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
70: 
71: 	//enable mac and phy clock
72: 	bk_pm_clock_ctrl(PM_CLK_ID_MAC, PM_CLK_CTRL_PWR_UP);
73: 	bk_pm_clock_ctrl(PM_CLK_ID_PHY, PM_CLK_CTRL_PWR_UP);
74: 
75: 	/* Wi-Fi VOTE RF */
76:     rf_module_vote_ctrl(RF_OPEN, RF_BY_WIFI_BIT);
77: 
78: 	/*
79: 	 * UMAC/LMAC init.
80: 	 *
81: 	 * Per the test result, rwnxl_init must be called before calibration init,
82: 	 * otherwise, calibration can't work correctly.
83: 	 * TODO: pass config to `rwnxl_init' to configure mac/phy/rf features.
84: 	 */
85: 	rwnxl_init();
86: 
87: 	/* RF calibration */
88: 	ret = calibration_init();
89: 	if (ret != BK_OK) {
90: 		WIFI_LOGI("cal init failed, ret(%x)\n", ret);
91: 		return ret;
92: 	}
93: 
94: 	/* TODO optimize it, move common param init to other places */
95: 	cfg_param_init();
96: 
97: 	pm_init_todo_2();
98: 
99: 	/*
100: 	 * start ke_event handler thread named `core_thread', and
101: 	 * start ke_msg recv thread named `kmsgbk''.
102: 	 */
103: 	ret = rwnx_intf_init();
104: 	if (ret != BK_OK) {
105: 		WIFI_LOGI("rwnx init failed, ret(%x)\n", ret);
106: 		return ret;
107: 	}
108: 
109: #if 0//(CONFIG_NO_HOSTED && CONFIG_RF_POLICY_SUPPORT)
110: 	ret = coex_init();
111: 	if (ret != BK_OK) {
112: 		WIFI_LOGI("rf task init failed, ret(%x)\n", ret);
113: 		return ret;
114: 	}
115: #endif
116: 
117: 	/* initial wlan rx buf only once after lwip has been initialized */
118: 	fhost_rxbuf_push(); //TODO choose a better name
119: 
120: 	/* start wpa_supplicant/hostapd eloop thread */
121: 	wpas_thread_start(); //TODO Choose a better name
122: 	
123: 	extern void coex_ictw_report_wifi_open_status(bool is_wifi_open);
124: 	coex_ictw_report_wifi_open_status(true);
125: 
126: 	return BK_OK;

164: static u8 mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
165: {
166: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
167: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
168: 	u16 			chnl_type;
169: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
170: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
171: 
172: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
173: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
174: 
175: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
176: 		return 4;
177: 
178: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
179: 		return 5;
180: 
181: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
182: 		return 3;
183: 
184: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
185: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
186: 
187: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
188: 		return 1;
189: 
190: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
191: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
192: 
193: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
194: 
195: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
196: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
197: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
198: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
199: 
200: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
201: 
202: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
203: 
204: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
205: 
206: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
207: 
208: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
209: 	{
210: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
211: 
212: 		return 2;
213: 	}
214: 
215: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_ILDE;
216: 
217: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
218: 	{
219: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
220: 	}
221: 
222: 	return 0;
223: }
224: 
225: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
226: {
227: 	u8		log_chnl;
228: 	u8		ret_code;
229: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
230: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
231: 
232: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
233: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
234: 
235: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;

48: #define IPC_XCHG_DATA_MAX		40 // MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN
49: 
50: typedef union
51: {
52: 	struct
53: 	{
54: 		mb_chnl_hdr_t	chnl_hdr;
55: 		void *	cmd_buff;
56: 		u16		cmd_data_len;
57: 	};

59: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t	mb_cmd;

63: {
64: 	struct
65: 	{
66: 		mb_chnl_hdr_t	chnl_hdr;
67: 		void *	rsp_buff;
68: 		u16		rsp_data_len;
69: 	};
70: 
71: 	mb_chnl_ack_t	mb_ack;
72: } ipc_rsp_t;

74: typedef u32 (* ipc_rx_cmd_hdlr_t)(void * chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf);
75: 
76: typedef struct
77: {
78: 	/* chnl data */
79: 	u8					chnl_inited;
80: 	u8					chnl_id;
81: 	beken_semaphore_t	chnl_sema;
82: 
83: 	/* tx cmd data */
84: 	beken_semaphore_t	rsp_sema;
85: 	u8			*	tx_xchg_buff;
86: 	u8				tx_cmd;
87: 	volatile u8		tx_cmd_in_process;
88: 	volatile u8		tx_cmd_failed;
89: 	u32				rsp_buf[IPC_XCHG_DATA_MAX / sizeof(u32)];
90: 	u16				rsp_len;
91: 
92: 	/* rx cmd data */
93: 	ipc_rx_cmd_hdlr_t	rx_cmd_handler;
94: 	u8			*	rx_xchg_buff;
95: 	u8				rx_cmd;
96: 	volatile u8		rx_cmd_in_process;
97: 	u32				cmd_buf[IPC_XCHG_DATA_MAX / sizeof(u32)];
98: 	u16				cmd_len;
99: } ipc_chnl_cb_t;

104: #endif // CONFIG_FREERTOS_SMP
105: static inline uint32_t ipc_enter_critical()
106: {
107: 	uint32_t flags = rtos_disable_int();
108: 
109: #ifdef CONFIG_FREERTOS_SMP

111: #endif // CONFIG_FREERTOS_SMP

120: #endif // CONFIG_FREERTOS_SMP
121: 
122: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
123: }

125: static void ipc_cmd_rx_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
126: {
127: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
128: 	mb_chnl_ack_t * ack_buf = (mb_chnl_ack_t *)cmd_buf;
129: 	ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (ipc_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
130: 
131: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == ipc_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
132: 
133: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_FLAG)  /* ipc rsp from other CPU. */
134: 	{
135: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* unsolicited ipc response. */
136: 		{
137: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
138: 		}
139: 
140: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd != (cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_MASK))
141: 		{
142: 			/* un-matched rpc response. */
143: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
144: 		}
145: 
146: 		/* communication ok, function is completed. */
147: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
148: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
149: 
150: 		BK_LOGI(MOD_TAG, "IPC_RSP_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
151: 
152: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
153: 		{
154: 			/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
155: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
156: 			chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
157: 		}
158: 		else
159: 		{
160: 			/* returns ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
161: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
162: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
163: 			{
164: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
165: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
166: 				#endif
167: 				
168: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
169: 
170: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
171: 			}
172: 			else
173: 			{
174: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
175: 			}
176: 		}
177: 
178: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
179: 
180: 		ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
181: 
182: 		/* it is a rsp command, nothing need to be returned. */
183: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = NULL;
184: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
185: 
186: 		result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
187: 
188: 		goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
189: 	}
190: 	else
191: 	{
192: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
193: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 1;
194: 
195: 		BK_LOGD(MOD_TAG, "IPC_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
196: 
197: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->cmd_buf))
198: 		{
199: 			result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
200: 		}
201: 		else
202: 		{
203: 			/* may return ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
204: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
205: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
206: 			{
207: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
208: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
209: 				#endif
210: 				
211: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->cmd_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
212: 
213: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
214: 			}
215: 			else
216: 			{
217: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = 0;
218: 			}
219: 
220: 			result = chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler(chnl_cb, ack_buf);
221: 		}
222: 
223: 		if(result != ACK_STATE_PENDING)
224: 			chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 0;
225: 	}
226: 
227: ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit:
228: 
229: 	/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle complete.
230: 	 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
231: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
232: 	 */
233: 	ack_buf->ack_state = result;
234: 
235: 	return;
236: 
237: }
238: 
239: static void ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
240: {
241: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.cmd == chnl_cb->tx_cmd)
242: 	{
243: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* RSP_CMD rx_isr may arrive before this tx_cmpl_isr. */
244: 			return;
245: 
246: 		/* IPC cmd tx complete. */
247: 
248: 		if( (ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) 
249: 			|| (ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_FAIL) )
250: 		{
251: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
252: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;
253: 
254: 			/* communication failed or function failed. */
255: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
256: 		}
257: 		else if(ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_COMPLETE)
258: 		{
259: 			/* communication ok, function is completed. */
260: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
261: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
262: 
263: 			ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
264: 
265: 			/* chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
266: 
267: 			if(ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
268: 			{
269: 				/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
270: 				chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
271: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
272: 			}
273: 			else
274: 			{
275: 				if((ipc_rsp->rsp_buff != NULL) && (ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > 0))
276: 				{
277: 					#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
278: 					flush_dcache(ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);;
279: 					#endif
280: 
281: 					memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
282: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len;
283: 				}
284: 				else
285: 				{
286: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
287: 				}
288: 			}
289: 			
290: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
291: 		}
292: 		else
293: 		{
294: 			/* communication ok, function is pending. */
295: 		}
296: 
297: 		return;
298: 	}
299: 
300: 	/*
301: 	 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
302: 	 */
303: 	BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault in %s,cmd:%d\r\n", __func__, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
304: 
305: 	return;
306: 
307: }
308: 
309: static bk_err_t ipc_chnl_init(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id, ipc_rx_cmd_hdlr_t rx_handler)
310: {
311: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
312: 
313: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
314: 		return BK_OK;
315: 
316: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(ipc_chnl_cb_t));
317: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
318: 
319: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
320: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
321: 
322: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) || 
323: 		(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
324: 	{
325: 		return BK_FAIL;
326: 	}
327: 
328: 	ret_code = rtos_init_semaphore_adv(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, 1, 1);
329: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
330: 	{
331: 		return ret_code;
332: 	}
333: 
334: 	ret_code = rtos_init_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, 1);
335: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
336: 	{
337: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
338: 
339: 		return ret_code;

41: /* =================================
42:  *
43:  * port num configuration
44:  *
45:  * ===============================*/
46: #define SERVER_PORT_NUM		4   // max reserved server PORT num supported by this design is 15 (1~15).
47: #define MAX_CONNET_PER_SVR	3   // at most 3 clients could connect to one server. max support value is 4.
48: #define CLIENT_PORT_NUM		12  // max client PORT num supported by this design is 48 (16~63).
49: 
50: #define SERVER_PORT_MIN		1   // port 0 is invaid.
51: #define SERVER_PORT_MAX		(SERVER_PORT_MIN + SERVER_PORT_NUM - 1)   
52: #define SERVER_SOCKET_NUM	(SERVER_PORT_NUM * MAX_CONNET_PER_SVR)
53: 
54: #define CLIENT_PORT_MIN		16
55: #define CLIENT_PORT_MAX		(CLIENT_PORT_MIN + CLIENT_PORT_NUM - 1)
56: #define CLIENT_SOCKET_NUM	CLIENT_PORT_NUM   // CLIENT_PORT_NUM == SERVER_SOCKET_NUM, because 1-1 connection.
57: 
58: #define IPC_SOCKET_NUM		(SERVER_SOCKET_NUM + CLIENT_SOCKET_NUM)
59: 
60: #define IS_SERVER_PORT(port)      ( (port >= SERVER_PORT_MIN) && (port <= SERVER_PORT_MAX) )
61: #define IS_CLIENT_PORT(port)      ( (port >= CLIENT_PORT_MIN) && (port <= CLIENT_PORT_MAX) )
62: 
63: #define IS_NOT_SERVER_PORT(port)      ( (port < SERVER_PORT_MIN) || (port > SERVER_PORT_MAX) )
64: #define IS_NOT_CLIENT_PORT(port)      ( (port < CLIENT_PORT_MIN) || (port > CLIENT_PORT_MAX) )
65: 
66: #define IPC_PARAM1_MASK		0x00FFFFFF	/* used to get byte0~2 of param1. */
67: 
68: typedef union
69: {
70: 	struct
71: 	{
72: 		mb_chnl_hdr_t    hdr;  // used internally by logical chnl driver.
73: 
74: 		/* u32   param1; */  /* this param1 is used internally by router/API-implemant layer. */
75: 		u8               dst_port      : 6;
76: 		u8               dst_cpu       : 2;   // byte-0
77: 		
78: 		u8               src_port      : 6;
79: 		u8               src_cpu       : 2;   // byte-1
80: 		
81: 		u8               tag              ;   // byte-2,.
82: 		
83: 		u8               api_impl_status  : 4;
84: 		u8               route_status     : 4;   // byte-3, used for router/api-implementation layer status.
85: 		
86: 		/* param2, param3 are used for API call parameters. */
87: 		/* u32   param2; */
88: 		u32              cmd_data_len  : 16;
89: 		u32              cmd_data_crc8 : 8;
90: 		u32              user_cmd      : 8;      // NOTE: 0xFF is an invalid ID.
91: 		
92: 		/* u32   param3; */
93: 		void           * cmd_data_buff;
94: 	};
95: 
96: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t	mb_cmd;
97: } mb_ipc_cmd_t;
98: 
99: #define SOCKET_CONNECT_ID_MASK		0x03
100:

102: {
103: 	struct
104: 	{
105: 		u8      src_port : 6;
106: 		u8      src_cpu  : 2;
107: 
108: 		u8      connect_id  : 2;   /* used for server port. support max 4 connections to server. */
109: 		u8      reserved1   : 5;
110: 		u8      sock_valid  : 1;
111:

113: 	};

125: } mb_ipc_route_t;

127: #define CTRL_RX_SEMA_NOTIFY       0x02
128: 
129: #define STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS       0x01
130: #define STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS       0x02
131: 
132: #define USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED        0x01
133: #define USE_FLAG_CONNECTED        0x02

135: typedef u32 (* mb_ipc_notify_isr_t)(u32  handle, u32 connect_id);
136:

145: 	u8                  src_port : 6;

| 核 | 配置入口 | 角色 | Wi-Fi 是否构建 | Wi-Fi6/RWNX 是否构建 | 主要通信角色 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CPU0/AP | `bk7258.defconfig` | 主系统、应用、Wi-Fi host/MAC/UMAC/LMAC 所在核 | 是 | 是 | 初始化 Wi-Fi；通过 mailbox 与 CP1/CP2 做通用跨核控制 |
| CPU1/CP1 | `bk7258_cp1.defconfig` | 从核、CPU1 system | 否 | 否 | mailbox/IPC 从核；不构建 Wi-Fi host |
| CPU2/CP2 | `bk7258_cp2.defconfig` | 从核、CPU2 system | 否 | 否 | mailbox 从核；`MAILBOX_IPC` 明确关闭；不构建 Wi-Fi host |

最重要的事实是：

1. **实际 Wi-Fi 只在 CPU0/AP 构建。**

4. AP/CP 之间确实存在 mailbox、逻辑通道、共享交换缓冲区和通用 IPC 控制面，但从当前配置和源代码可确认的内容看，它是**通用 AMP/系统控制通信**，不是 Wi-Fi 数据面。

```text
  └─ MAILBOX_IPC/socket IPC 关闭
```

因此，不能把这套工程描述成“Wi-Fi host 在 AP、MAC/LMAC/FHOST 数据面在 CP”。从配置和构建链实际选中结果看，**Wi-Fi 的 host、RWNX、FHOST、UMAC/LMAC 初始化和数据面均归属 CPU0/AP；AP/CP mailbox/IPC 是独立的通用跨核控制基础设施，目前没有证据证明它承载 Wi-Fi 专用控制面或数据面。**
